6671.title: Downstream cancellation leaves HTTP proxy connections open
6671.rootCauseOneLine: HTTP forwarding propagates upstream failures downstream but does not cancel the upstream request when its caller disconnects.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff addresses the observed missing cancellation; PR code was not executed.

6671.proposedFix: Cancel upstream work on downstream upload abort or premature response closure, preserve completed keepalive reuse, and guard late response/error callbacks.
6671.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two fresh trusted checkouts. Linux/Node 22 socket lifecycle verified; macOS system-wide buffer exhaustion and installed releases not tested. Existing open PR #6672 precludes a duplicate fix. Repro source is embedded in the HTML report.
